title: nan
authors: Tulembayev A.; Dolya A.; Kuttybayeva A.; Jussupbekov T.; Tazhen K.
key_contribution: Presents an energy-aware adaptive communication framework integrated with lightweight CNN-LSTM edge-AI navigation for decentralized UAV swarms in GNSS-denied environments, evaluated in ROS2/Gazebo/PX4 simulations.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
